title: The virgin and the gipsy
subjects: England -- Social life and customs -- 20th century -- Fiction
summary: The Virgin and the Gipsy is a 1930 novella by English author D. H. Lawrence. It was written in 1926 and published posthumously in 1930. Today it is often entitled The Virgin and the Gypsy which can lead to confusion because first and early editions had the spelling "Gipsy". (This summary is from Wikipedia.)
